title: Paper Cut
summary: Scrapbook collage: the speaker becomes a paper sticker over scribbles, with ransom-note letters.
description: The background is replaced with a handmade scrapbook page: off-white paper with a faint grid, a big blue crayon scribble, a torn yellow paper strip with navy scribbles and red ticks, pink scribbles, X marks and loop doodles. The speaker is cut out and turned into a paper sticker with a thick, slightly torn white border and a drop shadow, still talking. Ransom-note letters (mixed fonts on blue, white, black and yellow chips) thunk in one by one, a red marker ring draws itself around them, and a second word pops in underneath. Everything boils on threes like stop-motion.

options.headline: the ransom-note word or number, e.g. "100%", "3X", "FREE" ("auto" = a number from the transcript, else the strongest word)
options.subline: smaller second word under the ring, e.g. "EDITED" ("auto" = the next strong word, "" = none)
options.headlineAt: when the first letter lands (seconds or "@word")
options.sublineAt: when the subline starts (null = right after the ring)
options.circle: draw the red marker ring around the headline (true/false)
options.headlineX: left edge of the headline as a 0-1 fraction of the width (when headlineAlign is left)
options.headlineY: vertical centre of the headline, 0-1 of the height
options.headlineSize: maximum letter size in px at 1080 wide (long words shrink to fit)
options.headlineWidth: maximum headline width as a fraction of the frame
options.sublineScale: subline letter size relative to the headline
options.stickerScale: "auto" (fits the head to headTopTarget) or a number like 0.75
options.headTopTarget: auto scale: where the top of the head should land, 0-1 of the height
options.stickerX: horizontal centre of the sticker, 0-1 of the width
options.borderWidth: white sticker border thickness in px
options.tornEdge: how ragged the border edge is (0 = clean)
options.boilEvery: re-jitter the scribbles every N frames
options.colors: palette: paper, grid, blue, blueDark, yellow, navy, pink, red, ring, border
